implementation_notes: Return an unexported concrete type from a constructor and let callers depend on the interface. Keep struct fields unexported; expose behaviour, not state. Channels and context.Context are abstractions the caller treats as opaque.
idiom_name: unexported struct + constructor returning it + consumer-side interface
pitfalls: Exporting the struct so other packages can build it directly
Returning a pointer to internal slice so callers append into it
